enforcement_flags.permission_mode: --permission-mode <manual|acceptEdits|auto|dontAsk|plan|bypassPermissions>  (adapter uses a non-bypass mode; bypassPermissions is REJECTED)

max_turns_flag: NOT PRESENT in 2.1.215 — turn count is not a CLI flag; bounded instead by adapter wall-clock timeout + --max-budget-usd. Disclosed limitation, not a boundary insufficiency (allow/deny tools + permission-mode + budget + timeout are enforceable).
working_directory_behavior: child process cwd = the exact assigned job worktree (adapter sets spawn cwd); --add-dir bounds additional access
session_behavior: --print single-shot non-interactive; no interactive session created
auth_note: authentication (subscription/OAuth/keychain or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) is the user's existing local login; adapter NEVER reads, prints, or changes credentials; --bare enforces strict auth if a subscription-only condition requires it
